name: ibis-assistant
description: Living project memory over MCP for VS Code. Spawns an isolated Ibis Assistant (Rust) stdio child or attaches to a shared personal runtime for graph, logs, tickets, and typed memory.

enumDescriptions: Spawn an isolated `ibis-assistant -mode stdio -runtime-mode plugin` child (one per IDE, plugin data dir).
Attach to an already running shared runtime over Streamable HTTP (`#ibis.runtime.mcpUrl#`).
ibis.runtime.mode.markdownDescription: How the extension reaches Ibis MCP. `attach` is equivalent to setting the `IBIS_MCP_URL` environment variable and is the recommended way to share one personal daemon between Cursor and VS Code. The `IBIS_MCP_URL` environment variable is only honored while this setting is left at its default.

ibis.runtime.mcpUrl.markdownDescription: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint used when `#ibis.runtime.mode#` is `attach` (equivalent of the `IBIS_MCP_URL` environment variable). Start the daemon with `ibis-assistant run`.

ibis.runtime.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Command name or absolute path of the Ibis Assistant binary used when spawning (equivalent of the `IBIS_BIN` environment variable).

ibis.runtime.dataDir.markdownDescription: Override the plugin data directory (equivalent of the `IBIS_DATA_DIR` environment variable). Leave empty to use `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ibis-assistant\plugin` on Windows or the platform default.

ibis.runtime.runtimeMode.markdownDescription: Value passed to `-runtime-mode` for a spawned child. Keep `plugin` for IDE-owned stdio children; `personal`/`server` are advanced runtime deployments.

ibis.runtime.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra CLI arguments appended after `-mode stdio -runtime-mode <mode>` when spawning the child.

ibis.runtime.workspaceOverride.markdownDescription: Explicit opened-folder path exported as `IBIS_WORKSPACE` (equivalent of the `IBIS_WORKSPACE` environment variable). Leave empty to auto-detect the first VS Code workspace folder.

ibis.runtime.autoAttach.markdownDescription: When spawning would be used, first probe `#ibis.runtime.autoAttachProbeUrls#` and attach to a reachable personal runtime instead of starting an isolated child.

ibis.runtime.autoAttachProbeUrls.markdownDescription: Loopback Streamable HTTP MCP endpoints probed in order when `#ibis.runtime.autoAttach#` is enabled.

ibis.mcp.registerProvider.markdownDescription: Register the Ibis Assistant MCP server-definition provider so VS Code agent mode can start the server automatically. Requires a window reload when changed.

ibis.lmBridge.enabled.markdownDescription: Start the IDE language-model bridge on `127.0.0.1` so the runtime can use VS Code-provided models (runtime setting `ai.reasoning.use_ide_provided_models`). Requires a window reload when changed.

ibis.lmBridge.port.markdownDescription: Loopback port of the IDE LM bridge (equivalent of the `IBIS_LM_BRIDGE_PORT` environment variable). Requires a window reload when changed.

ibis.lmBridge.url.markdownDescription: Explicit bridge URL exported as `IBIS_LM_BRIDGE_URL` to the runtime (equivalent of the same environment variable). Leave empty to derive `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` from `#ibis.lmBridge.port#`.

ibis.lmBridge.modelFamily.markdownDescription: Optional `vscode.lm` model family filter (e.g. `gpt-4o`, `claude-3.5-sonnet`). Leave empty to use the first available IDE-provided model.

ibis.settings.url.markdownDescription: Explicit Ibis Settings UI URL opened by **Ibis: Open Settings** (equivalent of the `IBIS_SETTINGS_URL` environment variable). Leave empty to probe `#ibis.settings.probeUrls#` and fall back to the MCP `settings_open_ui` tool.

ibis.settings.probeUrls.markdownDescription: Personal Settings UI endpoints probed in order by **Ibis: Open Settings** before falling back to the ephemeral loopback Settings URL from MCP `settings_open_ui`.

ibis.settings.probeTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Per-endpoint timeout (milliseconds) when probing personal HTTP settings and auto-attach URLs.

enumDescriptions: Always show the kind quick pick in **Ibis: Remember**.
A choice the team should keep.
A hard boundary the project must respect.
A trap future agents should avoid.
A verifiable statement about the project.
ibis.memory.defaultKind.markdownDescription: Typed memory kind used by **Ibis: Remember**. `ask` keeps the interactive quick pick; any other value skips it and writes directly.

enumDescriptions: Sharing-first default: any client that can reach the runtime sees it.
Visible only to the resolved owner actor.

ibis.workingState.useWorkspaceProject.markdownDescription: Send the first workspace folder name as `project_name` when **Ibis: Set working state** calls MCP `set_working_state`.

enumDescriptions: Show **Ibis: Status** as a notification window.
Write **Ibis: Status** and diagnostics to the Ibis Assistant output channel.
ibis.status.outputMode.markdownDescription: Where **Ibis: Status** reports backend, shared-runtime, and LM-bridge details.

ibis.debug.verboseLogging.markdownDescription: Log verbose activation and backend-resolution details to the Ibis Assistant output channel.
